### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in both files are related in that they address the same underlying issue of potential race conditions when accessing the `adapter->afu` array. By introducing spin-locks in both `pci.c` and `guest.c`, the patch ensures that any access to the `afu` array is synchronized, preventing simultaneous read/write operations that could lead to NULL pointer dereferences and kernel crashes. This consistent approach across different parts of the codebase enhances the stability and reliability of the CXL module during error handling and device management operations.
